name: Python 3.14
updateContentCommand: if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y < packages.txt; fi; python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel; python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

postAttachCommand.server: set -e; python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel; python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; fi; UV_BIN=$(command -v uv || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/uv"); "$UV_BIN" run streamlit run streamlit_app.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
